post.description: Creates a new document in Edusign from Base64.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

directoryId.description: Sélectionnez le dossier existant dans lequel vous souhaitez enregistrer les documents que vous créez

trainingId.description: This field is used to select the existing training in which you want to link the documents you are creating

sendDocumentToSignByEmail.description: This field is used to choose if the document should be sent by email to all recipients to allow them to sign it. Default: true

sendDocumentByEmailWhenCompleted.description: This field is used to choose if the document should be sent by email to all recipients once it is fully signed. Default: true

redirectionLinkOnceSigned.description: Redirigez l'utilisateur vers une URL spécifique une fois qu'il a signé

signatureValidationMethod.description: Allowed values: "email", "sms", "none" (none make the signature validation optional). Default: "email"

signWithOrder.description: This field allows to send the document to the recipients one after the other only when the previous recipient has signed

expirationDate.description: This field allows you to define a date from which it will no longer be possible to sign the document

sendCustomSignatureReminderEmail.amount.description: The number of reminder emails you want to send

sendCustomSignatureReminderEmail.interva.description: The interval in hours between each reminder email (in hours)

adminId.description: The ID of the admin who sends the document

recipients[].description:
An array containing arrays of recipients for each document to be sent
Each array of recipients represents a document that will be sent. All recipient arrays must be identical (same number of recipients in the same order), only the IDs must be different from one array to another WARNING : All recipient arrays must be identical (same number of recipients in the same order), only the IDs must be different from one array to another

document.description: The document you want to send

document.base64.description: The base64 string of the document

useNativeCoordinates.description: This field allows you to use native coordinates for the document? If true, the coordinates will be used as is, if false, the coordinates will be scaled to the document size

get.description: Retrieves courses from Edusign.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Query param for pagination, starts at page "0" and displays 40 courses per page

schema.description: Query param for pagination, starts at page "0" and displays 40 courses per page

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Filter courses based on the course start date (format YYYY-MM-DD, ISO 8601)

schema.description: Filter courses based on the course start date (format YYYY-MM-DD, ISO 8601)

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Filter courses based on the course end date (format YYYY-MM-DD, ISO 8601). The difference between the start and end date must be 90 days maximum

schema.description: Filter courses based on the course end date (format YYYY-MM-DD, ISO 8601). The difference between the start and end date must be 90 days maximum

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description:
Filters must be separated by a comma ",". List of available filters :
- locked : Retrieve all the locked courses
- unlocked : Retrieve all the unlocked courses
- absencessent : Retrieve all the absences send courses
- absencesnotsent : Retrieve all the absences not send courses

schema.description:
Filters must be separated by a comma ",". List of available filters :
- locked : Retrieve all the locked courses
- unlocked : Retrieve all the unlocked courses
- absencessent : Retrieve all the absences send courses
- absencesnotsent : Retrieve all the absences not send courses

parameters.name: groupId
parameters.description:
Filter courses based on an array of groupIds to retrieve courses for specific groups
Multiple groupIds can be provided, separated by commas (e.g., ?groupId=123,456,789).

schema.description:
Filter courses based on an array of groupIds to retrieve courses for specific groups
Multiple groupIds can be provided, separated by commas (e.g., ?groupId=123,456,789).

parameters.name: studentId

Filter courses based on an array of studentIds to retrieve courses for specific students.
Multiple studentIds can be provided, separated by commas (e.g., ?studentId=123,456,789).

schema.description:
Filter courses based on an array of studentIds to retrieve courses for specific students.
Multiple studentIds can be provided, separated by commas (e.g., ?studentId=123,456,789).

parameters.name: professorId
parameters.description:
Filter courses based on an array of professorIds to retrieve courses for specific professors.
Multiple professorIds can be provided, separated by commas (e.g., ?studentId=123,456,789).

schema.description:
Filter courses based on an array of professorIds to retrieve courses for specific professors.
Multiple professorIds can be provided, separated by commas (e.g., ?studentId=123,456,789).

parameters.name: trainingId
parameters.description:
Filter courses based on an array of trainingIds.
Multiple trainingIds can be provided, separated by commas (e.g., ?trainingId=training123,training456).

schema.description:
Filter courses based on an array of trainingIds.
Multiple trainingIds can be provided, separated by commas (e.g., ?trainingId=training123,training456).

parameters.name: classroom
parameters.description: Filter courses based on the classroom.

schema.description: Filter courses based on the classroom.

parameters.name: creatorId
parameters.description: Filter courses based on creatorId to retrieve courses for specific creatorId

parameters.name: courseName

schema.description: Filter courses based on courseName to retrieve courses for specific courseName

parameters.description:
Filter courses based on an array of two dates (start and end)
(e.g., ?dateCreated=2024-08-01, 2024-08-02).

schema.description:
Filter courses based on an array of two dates (start and end)
(e.g., ?dateCreated=2024-08-01, 2024-08-02).

parameters.name: infoStudents
parameters.description:
Returns detailed student information for the first course only.
Values: "true" or "false" (default)
Example: ?infoStudents=true
Description: If "true", includes student details (first name, last name, email). If "false", only student states are returned.

parameters.name: connectionId

parameters.description: Retrieve or not the HTML version of the document. WARNING : The weight of the HTML template can have an impact on the payload size and request speed, depending on the quantity of documents to retrieve.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Query param for pagination, starts at page "0" and displays "limit" documents per page, with a maximum of 500.

parameters.description: Query param for pagination, maximum of 500 documents per page.

parameters.name: recipientId
parameters.description:
Retrieve documents based on a recipient resource ID : 
- Student ID
- Professor ID
- External ID

schema.description:
Retrieve documents based on a recipient resource ID : 
- Student ID
- Professor ID
- External ID
- Admin ID (a user with the 'admin' rights in Edusign)

parameters.name: state
parameters.description:
Retrieve documents based on its signature state : 
- "completed" : All recipients have signed the document
- "pending" : At least one signature is still pending
- "expired" : The signature link is no longer available
- "refused" : The recipient(s) have refused to sign

schema.description:
